{{DISPLAYTITLE:ML_MOPOT_NM}}
{{TAGDEF|ML_MOPOT_NM|[integer]|0}}

Description: Specifies the number of Morse-potential pairs used as auxiliary potentials in thermodynamic integration ({{TAG|VCAIMAGES}}).
----
This parameter sets the number of pairs for which the following Morse potential is used

<math>
V(r) = D_e (1-e^{-\beta(r-r_{e})})^2 - 1.
</math>

Setting this tag to 0 switches Morse potentials off.
